title: netwatch diagnose export, version 1
description: The JSON document inside the gzip file netwatch diagnose export writes. This schema covers the envelope, which is stable: later minors may add fields, so ignore any you do not know, and a break needs netwatch 2.0 and a new schema file. Each entry in episodes is a recording in the episode format, which is experimental and can change in any release. This file describes what netwatch 0.40 and later write; 0.39 has no metadata block.

metadata.description: Names this output's schema. Every stable netwatch output has this block, at the same path.

netwatch_version.description: The netwatch that wrote this bundle.

version.description: The version of this envelope, the integer form of metadata.schema_version. Not the netwatch version.

created.description: Local wall-clock time on the host that wrote the bundle, with no UTC offset. This is not UTC, so do not parse it as UTC.

install.description: A keyed hash that stays the same for one install across bundles and links to nothing else about the machine.

redaction.description: What the bundle's redaction did, in words. The wording is not stable.

episodes.description: Redacted recordings. Experimental inside, apart from schema_version.

items.description: One recording. Everything but schema_version is experimental and is left undescribed here on purpose.

schema_version.description: This recording's episode format version. netwatch refuses to replay a recording newer than it knows.
